narrative.overview: The site is a living notebook: paper grounds, one fountain-pen ink per theme, and a hand-marbled suminagashi print as the homepage's opening page. Engineering is the water beneath the paper — a real fluid simulation renders the print, and the visitor's pointer is the stylus. Nothing is decorated; everything that moves is either the visitor's own hand or the ink settling from it. Density is airy: generous margins, sparse ink, text always on clear paper.
keyCharacteristics: Paper-first grounds in four themes; every theme is a first-class citizen
One accent ink per theme from CSS custom properties; hue-rotated companion only inside the print
Fibre-jittered Bayer halftone dots as the texture language
The engineering is the aesthetic: effects are real mechanics, never canned decoration

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Exactly one accent hue per theme carries every accent use on a surface; the companion hue may appear only inside the marbled print's duo-tone.

rules.name: The Notebook Hand Rule
rules.body: Serif carries voice; mono carries wayfinding. Mono never sets sentences.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat paper; nothing floats above the page. Depth is tonal, never shadowed.

rules.name: Water Only Under Hand
rules.body: Motion is earned by the visitor's hand. The marbling is the system's one authored mechanic; UI chrome stays still.

dos: Do derive every accent use from theme CSS custom properties
Do keep motion earned: water only under the visitor's hand
Do use the halftone dot language for any texture
Do budget effects as real mechanics with reduced-motion and no-WebGL parity
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue, gradients, shadows, or glass
Don't cover the lockup's clear lower-left margin
Don't simulate at frame-rate: fixed 16ms wall-clock substeps
